project.name: Reposilite
project.mechanism: Arbitrary file creation or overwrite through path traversal in Javadoc archive entries

selection_reason.bounded_target: One 153-line pre-fix Kotlin target file and one localized security patch.
selection_reason.comparison: Selected before ruby-saml because ruby-saml combines two CVEs, an XML parser differential, signature wrapping, and a seven-file patch.
selection_reason.known_scanner_warning: The prior Gradle wrapper partial-parse warning is outside the target Kotlin file and does not alter target ground truth.

pre_fix.confirmed_recovery: Requires human semantic adjudication target_match plus falsification status confirmed.
pre_fix.location_only: Pending human adjudication; not a target match.

post_fix.location_only: Pending human adjudication; not automatic persistence.

acceptance.non_target_findings: Remain unadjudicated because the project answer key is not exhaustive.
acceptance.production_planner: Forced target inclusion receives no production coverage credit. Target omission is planner coverage evidence, not a semantic model false negative.

prohibited_changes_after_run: batch, call, token, or timeout limits
